fields.Programmes: Numeric reference: MBA (General); MBA (Finance); MBA (Digital Marketing) [NCR-216]
fields.Intake — Published:
AICTE 2025–26: MBA General 60, Finance 60, Digital Marketing 60; total 180 across separate courses. Numeric reference is General 60. Current 2026–27 EOA not recovered.
Published numeric intake: 60
fields.Fees — Published:
Official 2026–27 schedule explicitly lists year 1 ₹2,50,000 and year 2 ₹2,50,000 for each MBA. Add one-time registration ₹2,000 and annual examination fee ₹7,500 × 2: scheduled academic reference ₹5,17,000. Refundable security ₹10,000 extra; gross reference including security ₹5,27,000 before application and living costs. Subject to subsequent fee revision.
Numeric fee reference ₹L: 5.17
fields.Fee Scope: Reference MBA General; Finance and Digital Marketing have the same published two-year tuition schedule. ₹2,50,000 + ₹2,50,000 tuition + ₹2,000 one-time registration + ₹7,500 × 2 annual examination = ₹5,17,000. Excludes ₹10,000 refundable security, application charges and hostel/mess. ₹1,250 charity/insurance allocations are already within the proposed fee and are not added again. Current scheduled academic reference, subject to subsequent revision.
